summary: The diff implements Promise.race in race.rs and follows the spec steps in order. Step 1-2 call NewPromiseCapability with `?`. Step 3-4 wrap GetPromiseResolve (Get "resolve" then IsCallable check) and route throw completions through reject_abrupt, which calls capability.[[Reject]] with `?` and returns the promise. Step 5-6 call GetIterator(sync) with the same IfAbruptRejectPromise handling. Step 7-8 run PerformPromiseRace (IteratorStepValue, Call promiseResolve with ctor as this, Invoke "then" with resolve/reject). On abrupt completion it calls IteratorClose only when iterator_record.done is false, then rejects. Step 9 returns the promise. The helpers (get_promise_resolve, perform_promise_race, reject_abrupt) are local to the file, which the ticket allows. There are no test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, and no fabricated return values. The remaining test262 failures come from String iterator and Promise.prototype.finally, which are outside this ticket and throw not_implemented correctly. Minor nits only: the non-object `let Value::Object` branch is effectively unreachable because NewPromiseCapability already rejects non-constructors, and non-throw engine errors would pass through IteratorClose. Neither changes spec-observable behaviour for test262.
